section.title: Tianmen Mountain cable car closure: October 2026 route update

rows: From October 13, the notice suspends the Tianmen Mountain Cableway and Lines A/B; no reopening date is stated.
Mountain gate (山门) → Tianmen Cave Express Cableway → Tianmen Cave → upper escalators → summit; reverse to return.
The notice lists shuttles from the city cableway lower station to the mountain gate. Confirm your booked boarding point.
Keep two Wulingyuan days together and a separate Tianmen day. Check the current ticket route before fixing departure transport.

items: Route sources checked October 22, 2026: the October 10 operator notice, reproduced by Zhangjiajie local media, and the October 12 Voice of Hunan report describe round-trip Line C during construction. This is dated guidance, not live availability.
The closed Tianmen Mountain Cableway and the separate Tianmen Cave Express Cableway (天门洞快线索道) are different systems. The notice does not say the entire mountain is closed.
The October 8–12 express-cableway maintenance arrangement has expired. Follow newer operator notices if the route changes again.

faqs.question: Is Tianmen Mountain cable car closed in October 2026?
faqs.answer: The dated notice suspends the Tianmen Mountain Cableway from October 13 until further notice. It provides round-trip Line C on the separate Tianmen Cave Express Cableway. Recheck your travel date with the operator.

faqs.question: Can I still include Tianmen Mountain in a three-day Zhangjiajie itinerary?
faqs.answer: The published Line C plan retains access via the mountain gate, express cableway and upper escalators. Keep a separate Tianmen day, follow current booking instructions and leave a departure buffer. Forest-park admission is separate.
